meta.title: Plugin Check do Bible by Midvash
meta.author: midvash
meta.description: Roda o Plugin Check oficial (wp.org) via WordPress Playground, sem Docker. Precisa de Node 24 (com Node 22 o Playground quebra com 'unreachable'). Uso: extrair dist/bible-by-midvash-<v>-wporg.zip num dir temporario e rodar: npx @wp-playground/cli run-blueprint --blueprint=scripts/pcp-blueprint.json --mount=<dir-extraido>/bible-by-midvash:/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/bible-by-midvash --mount=<dir-saida>:/wordpress/pcp-out — resultado em <dir-saida>/result.txt (a primeira linha confirma PHP e WP). O stdout do wp-cli e engolido pelo Playground e o subprocess do runcommand nao funciona la, dai o eval-file + launch=false + arquivo montado. A versao do PHP e do WP vem de preferredVersions (o passo wp-cli ignora a flag --php): troque 7.4 por 8.3 pra testar o outro extremo.

steps.data:
<?php // O PHPCS do Plugin Check tenta ler php://stdin, que nao existe no Playground: desliga essa leitura so neste sandbox.
$cfg = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/plugin-check/vendor/squizlabs/php_codesniffer/src/Config.php'; file_put_contents($cfg, str_replace("if (defined('STDIN') === false", "if (true", file_get_contents($cfg)));
$out = WP_CLI::runcommand('plugin check bible-by-midvash --format=json', array('return' => 'all', 'exit_error' => false, 'launch' => false)); file_put_contents('/wordpress/pcp-out/result.txt', PHP_VERSION . ' / WP ' . get_bloginfo('version') . "
" . $out->stdout . "
--STDERR--
" . $out->stderr . "
code=" . $out->return_code);
